max_loss_assumption.absolute_worst_case_usd: ~1.00 (full position locked OOR + swap-back drift + gas; assumes no catastrophic exploit)
max_loss_assumption.note: These exclude any catastrophic-exploit scenarios (rug, contract bug). Probe targets a known-good audited pool but no on-chain action is risk-free.

why_not_positive_ev_proof: At 20U notional the $0.0153 fixed_cost dominates every hold window's fee_proxy.

The only positive cell in the candidate pool's economics matrix is 100U / 24h / zero_il_lvr = +$0.038, and zero_il_lvr is an unrealistic scenario (it asserts no impermanent loss on a 24h WBNB/USDT LP, which we know to be false).
Realistic-scenario best for 20U is -$0.0156 at 15m and gets worse with hold.
There is therefore no claim that this probe is +EV.
why_still_worth_doing_as_channel_probe: Channel validation: the entire open/close path (approve → mint → in-range hold → decreaseLiquidity → collect → revoke) has never been exercised end-to-end with a real wallet on BSC PancakeSwap V3 from this codebase.
tokenId retrieval: actual NFT position tokenId can only be observed from the NFT Transfer event after a real mint. This calibrates downstream telemetry.

Actual fee accrual: pool-level fee_proxy is an upper-bound estimate (assumes position takes (notional / TVL_proxy) of the pool fee, ignoring tick-range concentration). A 15m real probe measures actual feeGrowthInside / tokensOwed delta for the chosen tickLower/tickUpper, which is the single most important calibration input for sizing 100/500/1000/2000U next.
Exit-quote stability: a 15m hold lets us measure how much the swap-back quote drifts in a single 15m window for a real-sized LP, which is currently estimated only from event-stream stats.
estimated_hold_time: 15 minutes initial, up to 30 minutes with manual extension if health_ok
success_criteria_for_probe_execution_if_: tokenId successfully observed from NFT Transfer event within 30s
net_pnl_usd within ±$1.00 of the worst-case loss model
failure_criteria_for_probe_execution_if_: any stop condition (S1..S10) triggers and forces unplanned exit
tokenId not retrievable within 30s of mint confirmation
exit quote unavailable longer than 60s + 1 retry
any process other than the probe touches a wallet / private key / live order during the probe window
